title: A letter from the Marines
text: A letter arrives under a Marine seal. The commander of {legacy.parent}'s old unit remembers the family, and offers you a recommendation to the Marines.

choices.label: Keep the letter
choices.text: A recruiter will take you seriously.

effects.text: You keep the letter folded in your coat. It feels heavier than paper should.

choices.label: Burn it
choices.text: Whatever you become, you will choose it yourself.

effects.text: You burn the letter. Nobody in the family ever mentions it again.
